title: Completion of the guide by the left pass
statement: Let $R$ be a positive natural number. Starting from the right guide of radius $R$, fill $R$ cells leftward, then write an interior mark at coordinate $-R$ and the left edge marker at coordinate $-R-1$. The resulting tape is the guide tape of radius $R$.
replaced:
Let $R > 0$.  Starting from the right guide of radius $R$, filling $R$ cells leftward
and then writing an interior mark at cell $-R$ and the left outer boundary marker at
cell $-R-1$ produces the completed guide of radius $R$: origin mark at $0$, interior
marks at all $z$ with $0 < |z| \le R$, boundary markers at $\pm(R+1)$, and blanks
elsewhere.
